intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic & Snorkeling
experiences.description: Escape to a secluded uninhabited sandbank for a romantic private picnic with champagne and fresh seafood, followed by guided snorkeling in the crystal-clear lagoon teeming with colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and vibrant coral gardens. Perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate luxury experience.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, near Baros or Kuda Huraa

experiences.name: Manta Ray & Whale Shark Snorkeling Excursion
experiences.description: Join a guided boat excursion to world-renowned snorkeling hotspots where you can swim alongside majestic manta rays and gentle whale sharks in their natural habitat. A bucket-list experience for snorkeling enthusiasts, led by certified marine biologists who share insights about the Maldivian marine ecosystem.
experiences.location: South Ari Atoll, Hanifaru Bay, Baa Atoll

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples massage or beauty treatment inside a breathtaking underwater glass-walled spa suite, surrounded by the mesmerizing Indian Ocean and tropical marine life. This ultra-luxurious experience is the ultimate honeymoon pampering session and a defining symbol of Maldivian opulence.
experiences.location: Huvahendhoo Island, Alif Dhaal Atoll (COMO Cocoa Island or similar resort)

experiences.name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise & Overwater Dining
experiences.description: Set sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat at golden hour to spot playful spinner dolphins leaping through the waves. As the sun dips below the horizon, return to your resort for a romantic candlelit overwater dinner featuring freshly caught local tuna, lobster, and traditional Maldivian curries under a canopy of stars.

experiences.name: Malé Cultural City Tour & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant capital city of Malé, visiting the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) built in 1658, the National Museum showcasing Maldivian royal artifacts, and the bustling Local Market where fishermen bring in the daily catch. Sample authentic street food including mas huni (tuna and coconut) and hedhikaa (local snacks) for a genuine cultural immersion.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Malé Cultural City Tour & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant capital city of Malé, visiting the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) built in 1658, the National Museum showcasing Maldivian royal artifacts, and the bustling Local Market where fishermen bring in the daily catch. Sample authentic street food including mas huni (tuna and coconut) and hedhikaa (local snacks) for a genuine cultural immersion.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs. Arrange speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront room, freshen up, and take a quiet stroll on the beach under the stars to soak in your first Maldivian night.

meals.breakfast: On the plane
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light snacks from the airport convenience store or a quick bite at the resort's late-night snack bar upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your resort transfer before departure to avoid delays at the airport. Keep some USD or MVR (Maldivian Rufiyaa) handy for tips and small expenses. Confirm speedboat schedule with the resort as late-night transfers may be limited.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a leisurely wake-up, enjoy the beachfront view from your room. Head to the resort beach for a relaxing morning swim in the crystal-clear lagoon. Explore the resort grounds and get familiar with amenities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a snorkel set from the resort's water sports center (budget tip: negotiate a half-day rate). Head to the house reef just off the beachfront for your first snorkeling session. Discover colorful coral gardens, reef fish, sea turtles, and vibrant marine life right from the shore — no boat required.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the stunning Maldivian sunset from the beach with a mocktail or fresh coconut from a beach shack. Enjoy dinner at the resort's casual beachside restaurant. Early night to recover from jet lag.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet (included if part of package) or order à la carte — try local Mas Huni (tuna and coconut) with flatbread
meals.lunch: Pack a light picnic from the resort's grab-and-go counter or enjoy a simple rice and curry at the local staff canteen if accessible
meals.dinner: Resort beachside grill — opt for the catch-of-the-day grilled fish with rice, a budget-friendly and fresh option

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to help you adjust to the time zone. The house reef snorkeling is free or very low cost and is often as impressive as paid excursions. Ask resort staff about the best snorkeling tide times.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Malé Cultural City Tour & Local Market Visit. Take the resort's scheduled ferry or a budget public ferry to Malé. Visit the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) built in 1658, admire the intricate coral stone carvings, and explore the National Museum housed in the Sultan's Park for a small entry fee.
day_by_day.afternoon: Wander through the bustling Malé Local Market (Maachchangolhi Market) where locals sell fresh tuna, tropical fruits, and handmade crafts. Pick up affordable souvenirs like lacquerware, woven mats, and dried fish. Visit the colorful fish market at the harbor for an authentic local experience. Grab street food from local cafes called 'sai hotels'.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the waterfront promenade (Rasfannu) as the sun sets over the harbor. Watch the local fishermen return with their catch. Take the public ferry back to the resort island. Relax with a beach walk before dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort or local tea shop near the ferry terminal — try Roshi (flatbread) with curry
meals.lunch: Eat like a local at a Malé 'sai hotel' (local café) — a plate of short eats (hedhikaa) like bajiya and gulha costs under $3-5 USD
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — choose the set menu option for better value, or try grilled lobster if on special

day_by_day.notes: Public ferries from resort islands to Malé are significantly cheaper than speedboats — ask the resort for the schedule. Dress modestly when visiting mosques (cover shoulders and knees). The local market is most vibrant in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during high tide for the best visibility. Look for reef sharks, manta rays, and schools of tropical fish. Bring an underwater camera or use a waterproof phone case to capture memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling boat trip organized by the resort or a local operator. Visit 2-3 different snorkeling spots around the atoll, including a coral garden and a sandbank. These group trips are far more affordable than private charters.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic honeymoon-style sunset cruise — book a budget shared dhoni (traditional Maldivian boat) cruise. Watch the sun dip below the horizon while cruising the lagoon. Return to resort for a candlelit beach dinner.

meals.breakfast: Mas Huni with roshi at the resort — a traditional Maldivian breakfast perfect for an active day
meals.lunch: Packed lunch box from the resort or snacks on the snorkeling boat (often included in group tour packages)
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly for the honeymoon ambiance — beachside candlelit dinner at the resort with fresh seafood; look for set menus for value

day_by_day.notes: Book the group snorkeling trip at least a day in advance. Group tours typically cost $30-60 USD per person vs $150+ for private. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only to protect the coral ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a nearby local inhabited island by public ferry — a completely free or very low-cost experience. Walk through the quiet village streets, observe daily Maldivian life, and visit the local school and mosque (from outside). Chat with friendly locals and learn about island culture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy the local island's public beach, which is usually free and often beautiful. Swim and snorkel in the calm lagoon. Look for sea turtles that frequently visit shallow local island reefs. Visit a local guesthouse café for fresh lime juice.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by public ferry. Enjoy a relaxing spa treatment — opt for a shorter 30-minute massage instead of full packages to save money. Alternatively, do a DIY couples' spa night in your room with coconut oil.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fuel up for the island-hopping day
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island restaurant or home-style eatery — a full meal of fish curry, rice, and salad costs $5-8 USD
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — try the Maldivian curry night if available, or the buffet for value

day_by_day.notes: Local inhabited islands offer authentic cultural experiences at minimal cost. Always dress modestly on local islands (cover shoulders and knees). Public ferry schedules vary — confirm timings with resort staff the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a guided dolphin watching excursion — book through a local operator for budget rates. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters during morning hours. This is a magical and affordable experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort and spend the afternoon at the beach. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or kayaking — rent equipment by the hour to keep costs low. Paddle around the lagoon and explore the sandbank near the resort if accessible.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent beach walk — on clear nights, the shores of many Maldivian islands glow with bioluminescent plankton. Take a slow walk along the shoreline after dark and look for the magical blue glow in the waves. Free and utterly romantic.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early dolphin tour — grab a pastry and coffee from the resort café
meals.lunch: Resort lunch — try the fresh tuna salad or grilled fish sandwich for a lighter, budget-friendly meal
meals.dinner: Cook-your-catch style dinner if the resort offers it, or opt for a simple rice and curry at the resort restaurant

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching tours typically cost $25-50 USD per person in a group setting. The bioluminescence phenomenon depends on plankton activity — it's more visible on darker nights away from resort lighting. Ask resort staff which beach areas show it best.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint relaxation day — sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Read a book in a hammock on the beach, sip fresh coconut water, and simply enjoy the paradise around you. This is your honeymoon, after all — embrace the luxury of doing nothing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling at a new spot — ask resort staff to recommend the best nearby reef for this time of day and tide. Pack a small dry bag with water and snacks. Spend 2-3 hours exploring the underwater world at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset photography session on the beach — the Maldivian sunset is one of the most photogenic in the world. Use the golden hour light for couple photos. Then enjoy a quiet dinner and stargazing from the beach.

meals.breakfast: Splurge on a full resort breakfast buffet — eggs, tropical fruits, pastries, local dishes
meals.lunch: DIY picnic on the beach — buy fresh fruits, crackers, and local snacks from the resort shop
meals.dinner: Resort à la carte dinner — order grilled fish or chicken with local sides for a mid-range price point

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is intentionally low-key to prevent travel fatigue. Use this day to recharge, review your remaining itinerary, and book any upcoming excursions you haven't confirmed yet. Check with the resort about any complimentary activities for guests.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided manta ray snorkeling trip — seasonal but often available in March. Manta rays congregate at cleaning stations and feeding areas. This is a bucket-list experience and worth the cost. Book through a local dive operator for better rates than resort-organized trips.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit an underwater sandbank or a secluded sandbar accessible by short boat ride. Many local operators offer sandbar picnic trips at affordable group rates. Enjoy swimming, sunbathing, and snorkeling in the crystal waters surrounding the sandbar.
day_by_day.evening: Back at the resort, enjoy a couples' beach bonfire if available (check with resort). Roast marshmallows, listen to the ocean, and enjoy the stars. Alternatively, enjoy a quiet evening walk along the illuminated resort path.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the manta ray trip — toast, fruit, and coffee
meals.lunch: Sandbar picnic lunch — typically included in sandbar excursion packages (confirm when booking)
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — celebrate the manta ray sighting with a slightly special meal; try the seafood platter if within budget

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are not guaranteed but March is generally a good month. Book with operators who follow responsible wildlife watching guidelines — maintain distance and never touch the rays. Sandbar trips cost approximately $40-80 USD per couple in a group setting.

day_by_day.morning: Explore the resort's water sports offerings — try windsurfing or catamaran sailing with a beginner lesson. Many resorts offer complimentary introductory sessions for guests. Alternatively, join a free resort-organized yoga session on the beach if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a self-guided snorkeling tour around the resort's lagoon with a map from the dive center showing coral formations and marine life hotspots. Spend a leisurely 2-3 hours at your own pace. Look for octopus, lionfish, and moray eels in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the resort's overwater bar (if available) for sunset cocktails — order one drink each and savor the experience slowly to keep costs manageable. Watch the sky turn pink and orange over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Local-style breakfast at the resort — Garudhiya (fish broth soup) with rice if available, or the standard buffet
meals.lunch: Resort beach café — grilled fish wrap or tuna sandwich with fresh juice
meals.dinner: Budget-friendly resort set menu dinner or visit the à la carte menu and share a starter between two people

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort's activity desk about complimentary activities — many resorts offer free non-motorized water sports, yoga, and guided reef tours. These add significant value to your stay without extra cost.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to a nearby uninhabited island — arrange through a local fisherman or budget tour operator. Spend the morning on a pristine, deserted beach with no crowds. Collect shells, swim in turquoise waters, and enjoy complete tranquility.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling around the uninhabited island reef — often these reefs are less visited and in better condition than resort reefs. Look for nurse sharks resting on the sandy bottom and eagle rays gliding overhead. Return to resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Spa evening at the resort — book a 60-minute couples' massage during off-peak hours for potential discounts. Many resorts offer early evening specials. Alternatively, enjoy a romantic private beach setup that some resorts offer for free or minimal charge.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — pack extra fruit and snacks for the island day trip
meals.lunch: BYO picnic lunch on the uninhabited island — buy provisions from the resort shop the night before: sandwiches, fruit, water
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — try the Maldivian night special or the chef's recommendation for the freshest catch of the day

day_by_day.notes: Uninhabited island trips can be arranged informally with local fishermen at lower cost than resort-organized excursions. Bring plenty of water, reef-safe sunscreen, and a hat as there is no shade on many sandbars. Always confirm return boat times.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing trip on a traditional Maldivian dhoni — a classic experience and surprisingly affordable when booked with local fishermen. Try your hand at traditional line fishing. Any catch may be prepared for your dinner.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relaxed beach afternoon — this is your second-to-last full day, so soak it all in. Swim, sunbathe, read, and enjoy the resort facilities. Visit the resort gift shop to browse for souvenirs and pick up authentic Maldivian crafts.
day_by_day.afternoon_extra: If budget allows, try a short introductory scuba dive — a resort PADI discover scuba session costs approximately $80-120 USD and gives you a taste of the underwater world beyond snorkeling depth.
day_by_day.evening: Special honeymoon dinner — arrange with the resort in advance for a private beach dinner setup. Many resorts offer this experience at a premium but it can be negotiated or simplified. Light candles, star-filled sky, ocean sounds — pure magic.

meals.breakfast: Very early light breakfast before the fishing trip — granola, yogurt, and coffee
meals.lunch: Resort lunch — fresh tuna prepared from the morning catch if possible, or grilled fish at the beach café
meals.dinner: Special private beach dinner — splurge on this one night for the honeymoon experience; negotiate a set menu with the resort for a fixed, manageable price

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner is worth planning and budgeting for — it's the quintessential Maldivian honeymoon experience. Book at least 2-3 days in advance and specify any dietary requirements. Bring mosquito repellent for evening outdoor dining.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day — last snorkeling session at your favorite spot on the house reef. Take time to really observe and appreciate the marine life. Bring an underwater notebook to sketch or note species you've seen throughout the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack non-essentials and begin organizing luggage. Spend the afternoon at the resort pool or beach with a good book. Visit the resort's dive center to look at underwater photos if they offer photography services — you may purchase your favorites as a memento.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort — celebrate 12 wonderful days in the Maldives. Review your favorite memories, share highlights, and toast to the trip. Watch the stars one last time from the beach.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — enjoy every last item on the buffet
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the beach café — keep it simple as you'll have a big dinner
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's main restaurant — order your favorite dishes from the trip and splurge slightly on a bottle of sparkling water or fresh juice toast

day_by_day.notes: Settle any outstanding resort bills today to avoid morning rush. Confirm your transfer to the airport — timing, boat type, and pickup location. Leave a tip for resort staff who made your stay special. Back up all your photos to cloud storage.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one final sunrise on the beach — the Maldivian sunrise is as spectacular as the sunset. Take final photos and breathe in the ocean air. Enjoy a last breakfast at the resort and complete checkout formalities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort checkout and transfer to Velana International Airport via speedboat or ferry. Arrive at the airport with plenty of time for check-in and security. Browse the duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian honey, dried tuna, and local crafts make great souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Maldives. Carry wonderful memories of snorkeling adventures, pristine beaches, romantic sunsets, and the magical underwater world of the Indian Ocean's paradise islands.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy it fully before checkout
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — budget for a simple meal before your flight; international terminal has several options
meals.dinner: On the plane

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the resort-to-airport transfer, check-in, and security at Velana International Airport. Keep all receipts for any VAT refund claims if eligible. Maldives charges a Green Tax and Tourism Tax — confirm what's already included in your resort bill to avoid surprises at checkout.

trip_options.title: Classic Maldives Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer (confirm with resort in advance). Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, enjoy a welcome drink and light refreshments prepared by the resort staff.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack platter and tropical welcome drink provided at check-in by Aegean Bliss Resort

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is late at 22:30. Speedboat transfers typically run until midnight — confirm transfer timing with the resort prior to travel. Keep essentials (swimwear, sunscreen, medications) in carry-on for easy access. Rest well for the exciting days ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort's main restaurant overlooking the lagoon. Take a gentle stroll along your private beachfront, dip your toes in the crystal-clear turquoise water, and get acquainted with the resort's facilities — pool, beach loungers, and water sports center.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's house reef for an introductory snorkeling session. Rent snorkeling gear from the resort's water sports center and explore the vibrant coral gardens just steps from your beachfront villa. Spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations. Return to the beach for relaxation and sunbathing on your private stretch of sand.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach with a cocktail in hand. Head to the resort's beachside bar for sundowner drinks, then enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's main restaurant with fresh seafood and Maldivian specialties.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs made to order, and fresh juices
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch at the resort's beach shack or pool bar — grilled fish sandwiches, fresh salads, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the grilled catch of the day with local spices, steamed rice, and a glass of house wine (mid-range set menu approximately $40–$60 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to allow jet lag recovery. Ask resort staff about the weekly activity schedule and book experiences in advance. Apply reef-safe sunscreen before snorkeling to protect the coral ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: After breakfast, head to the resort's water sports center for a guided kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) session across the calm lagoon. Paddle around the resort island, enjoy panoramic views of the Indian Ocean, and spot marine life through the clear shallow waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book a 60-minute couples massage at the resort's overwater spa. Choose from traditional Maldivian Dhivehi treatments or Swedish relaxation massage. Enjoy the soothing sounds of the ocean beneath you as you unwind together in this tranquil setting.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beach walk at sunset. Head to the resort's overwater bar for cocktails and finger foods as the sky turns golden. Dine at the resort's specialty à la carte restaurant for a more intimate evening meal.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort — fresh fruit platters, yogurt, granola, and freshly brewed Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at the resort's poolside café — grilled prawns, tropical fruit salad, and iced lemongrass tea
meals.dinner: À la carte dinner at the resort's specialty restaurant — lobster bisque, grilled snapper with coconut curry sauce, and mango sorbet for dessert (approximately $50–$70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa treatment at least one day in advance, especially for couples' slots which fill up quickly. Wear light, breathable clothing for the evening as temperatures remain warm (around 28–30°C in March).

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Manta Ray & Whale Shark Snorkeling Excursion — join a guided boat excursion to world-renowned snorkeling hotspots. Depart from the resort jetty in the morning when sea conditions are optimal. Swim alongside majestic manta rays and, if lucky, the gentle giant whale shark in their natural habitat. Expert guides provide safety briefings and marine biology insights.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort after the excursion. Rinse off and relax on the beachfront. Enjoy a leisurely afternoon reading, napping in a hammock, or simply floating in the warm lagoon. Visit the resort's boutique to browse local handicrafts and Maldivian souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy sundowner drinks on your beachfront villa's private deck. Head to the resort's beach restaurant for a casual but delicious dinner under the stars with tiki torches lighting the shoreline.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before the excursion departs — light continental spread with pastries, fruits, and coffee
meals.lunch: Packed lunch box provided on the boat excursion — sandwiches, fresh fruit, snacks, and bottled water (typically included in excursion package)
meals.dinner: Beachside barbecue dinner at the resort — grilled fish, calamari, corn on the cob, and fresh salads with chilled local beer or mocktails (approximately $35–$50 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Manta Ray & Whale Shark Excursion typically costs $80–$120 per person. Bring underwater camera or GoPro for incredible footage. Whale shark sightings are more common between November and April, making March an excellent time. Apply waterproof reef-safe sunscreen generously.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning yoga or meditation session on the beach (check resort schedule) to start the day mindfully. Follow with a refreshing swim in the lagoon. Spend the rest of the morning exploring the resort island on foot or by bicycle — discover hidden coves, lush tropical vegetation, and quiet corners of the island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in the Underwater Spa Treatment — experience a signature couples massage or beauty treatment inside the resort's breathtaking underwater glass-walled spa room. Watch fish and marine life glide past the glass walls as you receive a deeply relaxing treatment. This is one of the most unique and memorable experiences the Maldives has to offer.
day_by_day.evening: Return to your beachfront villa for a private sundowner. Order in-villa cocktails and canapés through room service and enjoy them on your private beach terrace. Later, dine at the resort's overwater restaurant for a special romantic dinner.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort — eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, fresh tropical juices, and Maldivian roshi (flatbread) with tuna curry
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach café — club sandwich, fresh fruit smoothie, and coconut ice cream
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner — tasting menu with Maldivian-inspired dishes: tuna tartare, reef fish with lemongrass broth, and passion fruit panna cotta (approximately $60–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment is a premium experience and typically costs $150–$250 per couple. Book well in advance as it is the most sought-after spa experience at the resort. This is an ideal activity for a honeymoon celebration day.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Private Sandbank Picnic & Snorkeling experience — escape to a secluded uninhabited sandbank for a romantic private picnic with champagne and fresh seafood. A resort boat takes you to a pristine, remote sandbank surrounded by turquoise waters. Set up with a private picnic setup, lounge chairs, and a parasol.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel around the sandbank's surrounding reef, discovering colorful coral gardens and tropical fish in crystal-clear water. Enjoy the extraordinary feeling of being completely alone on a tiny strip of white sand in the middle of the Indian Ocean. Take stunning photos of the iconic Maldivian sandbank scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Freshen up and head to the resort's beach bar for the nightly sunset ritual with cocktails. Enjoy a relaxed dinner at the resort's casual dining venue.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort before departure — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and Maldivian fish soup (mas huni)
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic lunch — chilled champagne or sparkling juice, fresh lobster and prawn platter, artisan cheeses, tropical fruits, and gourmet sandwiches (included in the excursion package)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beach restaurant — wood-fired pizza, fresh salad, and gelato for dessert (approximately $30–$45 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic typically costs $200–$350 per couple and is one of the most iconic Maldives experiences. This is perfect for a honeymoon highlight or anniversary celebration. Bring a waterproof bag for your phone and camera. Sandbanks can shift or disappear — the resort will confirm the best location on the day.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a free morning at leisure — sleep in, order in-room breakfast, and spend time on your private beach. Take a slow morning swim in the lagoon and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the resort on a Sunday. Browse the resort's library or games room if you prefer indoor relaxation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a resort-organized glass-bottom boat tour over the house reef. Without getting wet, observe the vibrant underwater world of the reef — coral formations, reef sharks, turtles, and schools of tropical fish. This is a great option for a relaxed afternoon activity. Alternatively, try windsurfing or catamaran sailing lessons at the water sports center.
day_by_day.evening: Embark on the Sunset Dolphin Cruise & Overwater Dining experience — set sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat at golden hour to spot playful spinner dolphins leaping through the waves. After the cruise, enjoy an exclusive overwater dining setup with a curated menu and the sound of gentle waves below.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast ordered via room service — continental spread with fresh pastries, tropical fruits, and Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at the resort's poolside restaurant — fish tacos, guacamole, fresh lime juice, and a tropical fruit platter
meals.dinner: Overwater dining as part of the Sunset Dolphin Cruise package — three-course set menu with fresh seafood, Maldivian curry, and a decadent chocolate dessert with sparkling wine (approximately $80–$120 per person including the cruise)

day_by_day.notes: The Sunset Dolphin Cruise & Overwater Dining experience should be booked 2–3 days in advance. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters, especially at sunset. Bring a light shawl or jacket as evenings on the water can feel breezy. This is a magical honeymoon evening experience.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise snorkeling session at the house reef — morning light makes for the best underwater visibility and the reef is most active at dawn. Spot sleeping reef sharks, octopus, and early-rising tropical fish. Return for a hearty breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Malé Cultural City Tour & Local Market Visit — explore the vibrant capital city of Malé, visiting the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) built in the 17th century from coral stone, the colorful fish market, the presidential palace area, and the National Museum. Browse local shops for Maldivian handicrafts, lacquerware, and spices.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by speedboat in the late afternoon. Unwind with a refreshing drink at the beach bar. Enjoy a quiet dinner at the resort reflecting on the cultural discoveries of the day.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut), roshi flatbread, fresh juices, and tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Lunch at a local café in Malé during the city tour — try authentic Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa) such as bajiya (fish pastries), gulha (fish balls), and keemia (fish rolls) with sweet tea (approximately $5–$10 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — grilled barracuda, steamed vegetables, coconut rice, and a local dessert of bondibai (rice pudding with coconut milk) (approximately $40–$55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Malé City Tour typically costs $40–$70 per person including speedboat transfer. Dress modestly when visiting mosques — cover shoulders and knees. The fish market is most vibrant in the early afternoon. Carry some USD or Maldivian Rufiyaa for local market shopping. Malé is a compact city and easily walkable.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a morning of pure beach relaxation — set up on your private beachfront with a good book, tropical drinks, and the sound of gentle waves. Take occasional dips in the warm turquoise lagoon. This is a perfect mid-trip rest day to recharge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Try a new water sport — book a beginner wakeboarding or jet ski session at the resort's water sports center. Alternatively, take a guided snorkeling tour to a different section of the reef with a resort marine biologist who can identify species and explain the coral ecosystem in detail.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourselves to a romantic in-villa dining experience — pre-arrange with the resort to have a private candlelit dinner set up on your beachfront terrace with personalized menu, floral decorations, and soft music. This is an unforgettable honeymoon dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — avocado toast, smoked salmon bagel, fresh juices, and Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Beach picnic-style lunch ordered from the resort — wraps, fresh fruit, sparkling water, and coconut sorbet delivered to your beach lounger
meals.dinner: Private in-villa candlelit dinner on your beachfront terrace — curated 4-course menu: seafood starter, soup, grilled lobster main with garlic butter, and a honeymoon dessert platter with strawberries and chocolate (approximately $80–$100 per person, pre-arrange with concierge)

day_by_day.notes: Book the in-villa private dining at least 48 hours in advance through the resort's concierge. Specify any dietary restrictions or preferences. This experience typically includes a small surcharge of $30–$50 for setup and personalization. A truly special honeymoon memory.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling excursion to a nearby coral reef known for its abundance of marine life — ask the resort to arrange a boat trip to a more remote reef away from the resort's house reef for a fresh underwater experience. Look for Napoleon wrasse, eagle rays, and vibrant coral gardens.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at the infinity pool with cocktails. Take a cooking class at the resort (if offered) to learn how to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (fish broth), mas riha (fish curry), and fresh coconut sambal. A fun and interactive cultural experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a themed dinner night at the resort — many Maldivian resorts host weekly themed evenings (seafood night, Maldivian cultural night, etc.). Dress up slightly and enjoy the festive atmosphere with live music or traditional bodu beru drumming performance.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort — fresh tropical fruit platter, eggs any style, Maldivian fish soup, and fresh pastries
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — Caesar salad, grilled chicken skewers, fresh lemonade, and a scoop of tropical sorbet
meals.dinner: Themed dinner night at the resort — enjoy a spread of fresh seafood, traditional Maldivian curries, grilled meats, and live entertainment (approximately $45–$65 per person for themed buffet nights)

day_by_day.notes: Check the resort's weekly events calendar upon arrival to plan around themed nights and cultural performances. Bodu beru is traditional Maldivian drumming and dancing — a wonderful cultural experience. The cooking class, if available, typically costs $30–$50 per person and is a fun interactive activity.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning fishing trip with local Maldivian fishermen — a traditional line fishing (handline fishing) experience where you fish for tuna and reef fish at sunrise. This authentic cultural experience gives you a glimpse into the Maldivian way of life. The catch may even be prepared for your lunch!
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from fishing and relax on the beach. In the afternoon, visit the resort's boutique dive center for a Discover Scuba Diving introductory session in the shallow lagoon — perfect for non-divers who want to experience the underwater world more deeply than snorkeling allows. Certified divers can book a full guided dive.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final special evening — head to the overwater bar for sunset cocktails, then dine at the resort's finest restaurant for a premium dinner to celebrate your penultimate full day in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast — granola bar, fresh fruit, and coffee before the early departure. Full breakfast upon return to the resort.
meals.lunch: Fresh catch lunch at the resort — the morning's fishing catch grilled to order with lemon butter, steamed rice, and tropical salad (a truly farm-to-table experience)
meals.dinner: Fine dining at the resort's premium restaurant — five-course tasting menu with wine pairing: amuse bouche, seafood ceviche, lobster bisque, pan-seared reef fish, and a decadent chocolate fondant (approximately $80–$110 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The traditional fishing excursion typically costs $30–$50 per person and departs around 5:30–6:00 AM. The Discover Scuba session costs approximately $80–$120 per person including equipment and instructor. Book both activities the day before through the resort's activities desk.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkeling session at the house reef to say goodbye to the incredible marine life you have come to know over the past 12 days. Take your time underwater, appreciate the vibrant coral gardens and colorful fish one last time. Take underwater photos as lasting memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely afternoon of pure relaxation — lie on the beach, float in the lagoon, or indulge in one final spa treatment. Visit the resort's boutique to pick up last-minute gifts and souvenirs — Maldivian lacquerware, woven mats, local spices, and resort merchandise make wonderful keepsakes.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your final evening in the Maldives with a special farewell dinner. Watch the sunset from the beach with a glass of champagne, reminisce about the incredible experiences of the past 12 days, and enjoy a memorable last dinner under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory final full breakfast at the resort — order your favorites from the entire trip, fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and Maldivian specialties
meals.lunch: Farewell lunch at the resort's beach restaurant — grilled seafood platter with garlic bread, fresh salads, and tropical fruit juice
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's beachside restaurant — order your favorite dishes from the trip, share a bottle of wine, and enjoy a complimentary honeymoon dessert (inform the resort it is your last evening for a special touch)

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort concierge that it is your last evening — resorts often arrange a complimentary romantic gesture such as flower petals, a honeymoon cake, or sparkling wine for honeymooning couples. Begin packing non-essentials this evening to avoid a rushed morning. Confirm departure transfer details with the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a last sunrise on your beachfront terrace with a cup of Maldivian tea or coffee. Take a final walk along the beach, collect a handful of white sand as a memory, and soak in the breathtaking turquoise scenery one last time. Complete packing and check out of your villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy a final swim or lounge by the pool during late check-out (confirm with resort). Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport in Malé. Allow ample time for check-in, security, and immigration procedures.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives carrying incredible memories of a perfect balanced honeymoon — world-class snorkeling, luxurious spa treatments, romantic sandbank picnics, dolphin cruises, cultural discoveries, and 13 days of paradise in the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa or restaurant breakfast at the resort — keep it light and easy for travel: fresh fruit, yogurt, toast, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort before departure or at the airport — sandwiches, salad, and fresh juice
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Velana International Airport or on your return flight

day_by_day.notes: Check-out is typically at 12:00 noon but request a late check-out (until 2:00–3:00 PM) to maximize your final beach time — this is often complimentary for honeymooners. Confirm your speedboat or seaplane transfer time with the resort the night before. Allow at least 3 hours before your international flight for airport procedures. Keep all travel documents, passports, and boarding passes easily accessible.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic & Snorkeling
experiences.description: Escape to a secluded uninhabited sandbank for a romantic private picnic with champagne and fresh seafood, followed by guided snorkeling in the crystal-clear lagoon teeming with colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and vibrant coral gardens. Perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate luxury experience.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, near Baros or Kuda Huraa

experiences.name: Manta Ray & Whale Shark Snorkeling Excursion
experiences.description: Join a guided boat excursion to world-renowned snorkeling hotspots where you can swim alongside majestic manta rays and gentle whale sharks in their natural habitat. A bucket-list experience for snorkeling enthusiasts, led by certified marine biologists who share insights about the Maldivian marine ecosystem.
experiences.location: South Ari Atoll, Hanifaru Bay, Baa Atoll

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples massage or beauty treatment inside a breathtaking underwater glass-walled spa suite, surrounded by the mesmerizing Indian Ocean and tropical marine life. This ultra-luxurious experience is the ultimate honeymoon pampering session and a defining symbol of Maldivian opulence.
experiences.location: Huvahendhoo Island, Alif Dhaal Atoll (COMO Cocoa Island or similar resort)

experiences.name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise & Overwater Dining
experiences.description: Set sail on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat at golden hour to spot playful spinner dolphins leaping through the waves. As the sun dips below the horizon, return to your resort for a romantic candlelit overwater dinner featuring freshly caught local tuna, lobster, and traditional Maldivian curries under a canopy of stars.

experiences.name: Malé Cultural City Tour & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant capital city of Malé, visiting the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) built in 1658, the National Museum showcasing Maldivian royal artifacts, and the bustling Local Market where fishermen bring in the daily catch. Sample authentic street food including mas huni (tuna and coconut) and hedhikaa (local snacks) for a genuine cultural immersion.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler at the arrivals hall for a seamless VIP transfer. Board a private luxury speedboat transfer to the resort, enjoying the magical night sky over the Indian Ocean. Upon arrival, enjoy a private welcome ceremony with chilled champagne, tropical flower garlands, and a personal resort orientation by your villa host.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-transit)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-transit)
meals.dinner: A curated late-night welcome platter of Maldivian canapés, fresh tropical fruits, artisan cheeses, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon Champagne awaits in your Beachfront Villa upon check-in, courtesy of the resort.

day_by_day.notes: Late arrival — Day 1 is purely for arrival and settling in. Ensure resort is pre-notified of late check-in. All luggage will be handled by the butler team. Unwind, explore your villa, and enjoy the private beach under the stars before retiring.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely private breakfast on your beachfront villa deck. After breakfast, take your first stroll along the pristine white-sand beach and wade into the warm turquoise lagoon. Spend time acclimatizing to the resort — explore the overwater boardwalks, the infinity pool, and the beach club at your own pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's PADI-certified dive and water sports center for a complimentary snorkeling orientation session in the house reef. Discover vibrant coral gardens, sea turtles, and tropical fish just steps from your villa. Your dedicated water sports guide will introduce you to the best snorkeling spots within the resort lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: As the sun begins to set, settle into the resort's signature overwater bar for handcrafted cocktails and canapés while watching the sky turn golden over the Indian Ocean. Transition to a romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's premier beachfront restaurant, dining barefoot on the sand under a canopy of stars.

meals.breakfast: Private in-villa breakfast on your beachfront deck — freshly squeezed tropical juices, eggs Benedict, Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut), artisan pastries, and a French press coffee selection.
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach club — grilled lobster rolls, avocado salad, and chilled coconut water served directly to your sun lounger.
meals.dinner: Beachfront candlelit dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — a four-course set menu featuring seared scallops, Maldivian reef fish ceviche, butter-poached lobster tail, and a decadent chocolate fondant with vanilla bean ice cream. Paired with a curated wine selection.

day_by_day.notes: This is a gentle orientation day — no structured excursions to allow recovery from the late arrival. Request your butler to arrange a personalized activity schedule for the remainder of the trip. Ask about the resort's complimentary non-motorized water sports including kayaking and paddleboarding.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a sunrise yoga session on a private overwater yoga platform, led by the resort's resident instructor. Breathe in the fresh ocean air as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean — a truly magical and romantic experience. Follow with a healthy post-yoga breakfast back at the villa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Private Sandbank Picnic & Snorkeling experience. A private speedboat whisks you away to a secluded uninhabited sandbank surrounded by crystal-clear waters. Enjoy a lavishly prepared private picnic with chilled champagne, fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and gourmet sandwiches. After lunch, snorkel the pristine surrounding reef teeming with colorful marine life, including parrotfish, butterflyfish, and reef sharks.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Freshen up and indulge in a couples' sunset cocktail hour at your private villa beach. Your butler will arrange a personalized in-villa cocktail setup with a dedicated mixologist. End the evening with a romantic overwater dinner at the resort's glass-floor overwater restaurant, where you can watch reef fish swim beneath your feet.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga healthy breakfast at the villa — açaí bowls, smoked salmon bagels, granola with Maldivian honey, and freshly brewed single-origin coffee.
meals.lunch: Gourmet private sandbank picnic — chilled champagne, fresh lobster, prawn cocktail, artisan bread, tropical fruit platters, and decadent petit fours, all set up by the resort's private dining team.
meals.dinner: Overwater glass-floor restaurant — seven-course tasting menu with wine pairing, featuring Maldivian-inspired dishes such as tuna tartare, coconut-crusted snapper, and a passion fruit soufflé.

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic must be booked at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and light cover-up for the sandbank. The sandbank experience typically lasts 3–4 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for the Manta Ray & Whale Shark Snorkeling Excursion — one of the most extraordinary marine experiences in the Maldives. Board a private luxury dhoni boat with your expert marine biologist guide and head to world-renowned snorkeling hotspots. Swim alongside majestic manta rays and, if conditions are favorable, the awe-inspiring whale shark — the world's largest fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon, exhilarated from the morning's marine encounter. Spend the afternoon unwinding at the resort's adults-only infinity pool, sipping on fresh coconut cocktails and enjoying the panoramic ocean views. Alternatively, enjoy a private kayaking session around the resort's lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourselves to the Underwater Spa Treatment — a signature couples' massage inside a breathtaking underwater glass-walled spa chamber. Watch manta rays and tropical fish glide past as skilled therapists deliver a deeply relaxing 90-minute Balinese couples' massage using exotic Maldivian oils and botanicals. Afterward, enjoy a private champagne toast inside the spa.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the excursion — tropical fruit salad, yogurt parfait, croissants, and herbal teas served at the villa at 06:30.
meals.lunch: Post-excursion lunch at the resort's ocean-view terrace restaurant — fresh sashimi platter, miso-glazed black cod, edamame salad, and chilled sake.
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining experience — your butler and a private chef prepare a bespoke three-course dinner on your beachfront deck, with a personalized menu designed around your preferences. Includes a bottle of vintage Burgundy.

day_by_day.notes: The Manta Ray & Whale Shark Excursion departs early (approximately 06:00–06:30). Confirm departure time with the water sports center the evening before. Whale shark sightings are seasonal — March is an excellent time in the Maldives. The Underwater Spa must be booked in advance as slots are very limited.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a relaxed morning exploring the resort's house reef on a self-guided snorkeling adventure. The house reef is accessible directly from the beach and is one of the most biodiverse in the Maldives — look out for hawksbill turtles, nurse sharks, and vibrant coral formations. Spend at least two hours exploring before returning for brunch.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the resort's exclusive Marine Conservation Experience — join the resort's resident marine biologist for a coral gardening session. Learn about the resort's coral regeneration program, plant your own coral fragment on the reef, and receive a personalized certificate. A meaningful and memorable activity for couples.
day_by_day.evening: Set sail on the Sunset Dolphin Cruise & Overwater Dining experience. Board a beautifully decorated traditional Maldivian dhoni at golden hour and cruise the surrounding waters to spot playful spinner dolphins leaping and dancing alongside the boat. As darkness falls, the dhoni anchors at a stunning overwater dining platform where a private chef serves a spectacular seafood feast under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Brunch at the resort's main restaurant after snorkeling — eggs any style, Maldivian fish curry with roshi flatbread, fresh juices, and a mimosa bar.
meals.lunch: Light beach club lunch — grilled tiger prawns, Caesar salad, truffle fries, and a chilled rosé.
meals.dinner: Private overwater dining on the dhoni platform — whole grilled Maldivian lobster, grilled reef fish with coconut sambal, saffron rice, and a tropical pavlova for dessert, with a curated Champagne and wine selection.

day_by_day.notes: The Sunset Dolphin Cruise typically departs around 17:00–17:30. Bring a light layer as it can get breezy on the water after sunset. Dolphin sightings are very common in the Maldives — spinner dolphins are frequently spotted in these waters. Inform the team of any dietary restrictions for the overwater dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a private stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) lesson in the calm resort lagoon, followed by a leisurely paddle along the coastline. The crystal-clear water allows you to see the marine life beneath you as you paddle — an incredibly serene experience. Return for a late, indulgent breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Malé Cultural City Tour & Local Market Visit. A private speedboat transfers you to the vibrant Maldivian capital. Explore the historic Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque), built in 1658 from coral stone, and the adjacent cemetery. Visit the colorful Malé Fish Market and local bazaars, sample Maldivian street food, and browse local crafts and souvenirs. Your private guide provides fascinating historical and cultural context throughout.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a private stargazing experience arranged by your butler — a telescope is set up on your private beach with a printed star map, accompanied by a bottle of vintage Champagne and a curated cheese and charcuterie board. A truly romantic and unforgettable evening.

meals.breakfast: Late breakfast at the villa — eggs Florentine, smoked salmon blinis, tropical fruit, and a Bloody Mary or fresh juice.
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian lunch experience in Malé — sample local short eats (hedhikaa) including bajiya (fish pastries), gulha (fish balls), and keemia at a recommended local eatery, followed by a fresh sugarcane juice.
meals.dinner: Romantic in-villa dinner — your butler arranges a table on the beach with lanterns and flowers. Menu features a chilled gazpacho, pan-seared duck breast with truffle jus, and a vanilla crème brûlée, accompanied by a Pinot Noir.

day_by_day.notes: The Malé City Tour typically takes 3–4 hours. Dress modestly when visiting mosques (shoulders and knees covered). The fish market is most vibrant in the early afternoon. Confirm the speedboat schedule with the resort concierge the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to pure relaxation and indulgence. Book a morning slot at the resort's overwater spa for individual treatments — choose from a deep-tissue massage, a traditional Maldivian Dhivehi herbal treatment, or a luxury facial. Spend the remaining morning hours lounging on your private villa beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a private big-game fishing excursion on the resort's luxury sport fishing yacht. Head to the deep blue waters beyond the atoll to try your hand at trolling for yellowfin tuna, wahoo, or mahi-mahi with an experienced captain and first mate. Any catch can be prepared by the resort's chef for your dinner.
day_by_day.evening: The resort's chef prepares your fresh catch of the day in your preferred style — grilled, ceviche, or sashimi — served at a private beach dinner. If the fishing was not successful, choose from the restaurant's premium menu. Celebrate the halfway point of your trip with a bottle of vintage Dom Pérignon.

meals.breakfast: Pre-spa light breakfast — Greek yogurt, granola, fresh berries, and green tea.
meals.lunch: Onboard the fishing yacht — a packed gourmet lunch box with lobster wraps, fresh fruit, energy bars, and chilled sparkling water and juices.
meals.dinner: Private 'catch of the day' beach dinner — your fresh catch prepared by the resort's head chef, served with saffron risotto, grilled asparagus, and a lemon butter sauce. Dessert: a shared chocolate and raspberry tart.

day_by_day.notes: Big-game fishing excursions typically depart around 13:00 and return by 17:30. The resort operates a strict catch-and-release policy for protected species. Bring motion sickness medication if needed. The spa morning session should be booked 48 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise kayaking tour around the resort's lagoon and surrounding mangroves with a naturalist guide. Observe the incredible birdlife and the serene beauty of the Maldives at dawn — a peaceful and intimate experience. Return for a champagne breakfast on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a leisurely afternoon at the resort's private adults-only beach area. Enjoy premium sun loungers, chilled towel service, and personalized cocktail service. Opt for a private windsurfing or kitesurfing lesson with the resort's certified instructors if you're feeling adventurous.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the resort's exclusive 'Dining by Design' service — your butler and the culinary team transform a private location of your choosing (your villa deck, a secluded beach cove, or the end of the overwater jetty) into a bespoke fine-dining setting. A five-course menu is crafted personally for you by the executive chef.

meals.breakfast: Champagne beach breakfast post-kayaking — smoked salmon, scrambled eggs, fresh pastries, tropical fruits, and a glass of Billecart-Salmon Rosé Champagne.
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — wagyu beef sliders, truffle parmesan fries, a mixed green salad, and a glass of chilled Sancerre.
meals.dinner: Bespoke 'Dining by Design' private dinner — five courses personally crafted by the executive chef, featuring premium ingredients such as Wagyu beef, Hokkaido scallops, black truffle, and Valrhona chocolate. Full sommelier wine pairing included.

day_by_day.notes: 'Dining by Design' experiences are the resort's most exclusive dining offering and must be booked at least 72 hours in advance. Discuss your preferences, dietary requirements, and favorite ingredients with your butler so the chef can tailor the menu perfectly.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a second Manta Ray & Whale Shark Snorkeling Excursion, this time exploring a different set of snorkeling hotspots identified by the resort's marine team. Each day brings different marine encounters — this session may offer the chance to swim with schools of hammerhead sharks, eagle rays, and dense coral gardens in pristine condition.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a private couples' cooking class with the resort's executive chef. Learn to prepare authentic Maldivian dishes including mas riha (fish curry), garudhiya (fish broth), and coconut sambol. The class concludes with a private lunch of your creations enjoyed on the villa deck.
day_by_day.evening: Indulge in a second Underwater Spa Treatment — this time opt for a different treatment such as a hot stone therapy session or a traditional Ayurvedic Shirodhara treatment (warm oil poured over the forehead). Conclude the evening with a quiet drink at the overwater bar, watching the bioluminescent plankton light up the water below.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the excursion — energy bars, fresh fruit, yogurt, and green tea at 06:15.
meals.lunch: Your own Maldivian creations from the cooking class — mas riha fish curry with steamed rice, garudhiya broth, and freshly made coconut sambol, enjoyed on the villa deck.
meals.dinner: Post-spa dinner at the resort's Japanese-inspired omakase counter (if available) or the overwater restaurant — premium sashimi, wagyu tataki, miso black cod, and matcha ice cream.

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class is typically 2–3 hours long and must be booked in advance. Bioluminescent plankton is best viewed on darker nights away from artificial light — ask the bar team for the best viewing spot. Wear dark clothing to better see the glow in the water.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate this morning to a full spa morning — begin with a private hydrotherapy circuit in the spa's ocean-view thermal pools, steam room, and ice fountain. Follow with a 60-minute aromatherapy massage each and conclude with a rejuvenating vitamin C facial. Emerge completely refreshed and glowing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a private sunset sailing experience on the resort's luxury catamaran. Sail around the atoll, anchor at a secluded snorkeling spot, and spend the afternoon exploring the underwater world before sailing back as the sky turns pink and orange. Your personal steward serves chilled drinks and canapés throughout.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate with a special 'Over-the-Water' dinner experience — dine on a private platform suspended above the Indian Ocean, with lanterns reflected in the water below. The resort's sommelier presents a curated wine journey alongside a five-course menu celebrating the finest ingredients from the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Spa morning breakfast — light and nourishing: green smoothies, chia pudding, avocado toast, and herbal detox teas.
meals.lunch: Onboard the catamaran — a Mediterranean-style spread with hummus, pita, grilled halloumi, fresh seafood skewers, and a chilled Provence rosé.
meals.dinner: Over-the-water private platform dinner — five courses including a Maldivian lobster bisque, octopus carpaccio, pan-roasted sea bass, a cheese course, and a deconstructed lemon tart with champagne sorbet.

day_by_day.notes: The catamaran sailing excursion typically runs from 13:30 to 18:00. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and a light jacket for the sail back. The over-the-water dinner platform requires advance booking and is weather-dependent — the resort will arrange an equally romantic alternative if conditions are unfavorable.

day_by_day.morning: Spend a peaceful final full-experience morning on your private villa beach — swim in the warm turquoise lagoon, float on the resort's luxury pool inflatables, and simply soak in the extraordinary beauty of the Maldives. Order a leisurely brunch to your villa and enjoy it in your private pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a guided underwater photography or videography workshop with the resort's resident underwater photographer. Learn to capture stunning images of marine life on a provided underwater camera or your own device. The session includes a guided snorkel on the house reef and a post-session editing review. You'll leave with a curated album of professional-quality underwater memories.
day_by_day.evening: Participate in a private traditional Maldivian cultural evening arranged by the resort — enjoy a private Bodu Beru (traditional drumming) performance on the beach, followed by a themed Maldivian feast featuring an array of traditional dishes, served on a beautifully decorated beach setting with torchlight and flower arrangements.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent villa brunch — eggs Benedict with Maldivian smoked tuna, lobster omelette, fresh tropical fruit platter, freshly baked pastries, and a bottle of chilled Moët & Chandon.
meals.lunch: Light snack post-photography session — fresh coconut, tropical fruit skewers, and a cold-pressed juice at the beach club.
meals.dinner: Traditional Maldivian feast on the beach — mas riha, tuna curry, garudhiya, coconut roshi, rihaakuru (concentrated fish paste), and traditional Maldivian sweets, served with fresh coconut toddy (non-alcoholic) or premium cocktails.

day_by_day.notes: The underwater photography workshop is approximately 3 hours and is suitable for all skill levels. Request a USB drive or digital transfer of your best images from the resort photographer. The traditional cultural evening is a unique and memorable experience — inform the resort team 48 hours in advance to ensure proper arrangements.

day_by_day.morning: Begin your penultimate morning with a final sunrise swim in the Indian Ocean from your private beach. Afterward, take a slow, mindful walk around the entire resort island — a cherished ritual to absorb every detail of this paradise before departure. Enjoy a special anniversary or honeymoon breakfast prepared by the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a private island-hopping excursion by luxury speedboat, visiting two or three nearby uninhabited islands. Explore pristine beaches, collect shells, and snorkel in untouched reefs. A perfect way to see more of the Maldives' natural beauty beyond the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for your final evening. Enjoy a private champagne toast on your villa deck at sunset, reflecting on the extraordinary experiences of the past 12 days. Conclude with a spectacular farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — a true culinary celebration of your Maldives journey.

meals.breakfast: Special honeymoon/anniversary breakfast on the beach — heart-shaped pancakes, fresh strawberries and cream, smoked salmon, eggs any style, and a bottle of Laurent-Perrier Rosé Champagne.
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch on one of the uninhabited islands during the island-hopping excursion — grilled fish, fresh salads, tropical fruits, and chilled sparkling water.
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — an eight-course chef's tasting menu with full wine pairing, featuring the finest local and international ingredients. Ends with a personalized dessert plate with a 'Thank You for Staying' message from the chef.

day_by_day.notes: Pack your main luggage this evening for an easier departure tomorrow. Leave out only essentials needed for the morning. Your butler will arrange luggage collection and airport transfer. Request a late checkout if possible to maximize your final morning.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final leisurely morning at the resort. Take one last swim in the warm turquoise lagoon, have a final walk along your private beach, and collect any last souvenirs from the resort boutique. Enjoy a relaxed farewell breakfast with your butler.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Your personal butler oversees all luggage handling and accompanies you to the resort's private jetty for your VIP speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport. Arrive with ample time for your departure, carrying memories of an extraordinary 13-day Maldivian paradise escape.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry the warmth of the Maldives with you as you journey home.

meals.breakfast: Final farewell breakfast at the villa — your favorite items from throughout the stay, prepared as a special send-off by your villa chef. Includes fresh tropical juices, pastries, and a final Maldivian coffee.
meals.lunch: Light snack at the airport's premium lounge or onboard your flight.
meals.dinner: Onboard or at your connecting airport.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your checkout time and speedboat transfer schedule with your butler the evening before. Maldives airport transfers can take 20–45 minutes by speedboat depending on the resort's location. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight departure. Keep your resort contact card for any post-trip queries. Safe travels!
